articles.title: Jordan says its air force struck 'militant hideouts' in Syria after church attack
articles.description: Jordan said on Monday its air force struck what it described as militant hideouts in southern Syria after determining that the suspects behind last weeks deadly church attack in the kingdom were linked to terrorist groups operating there The armed forces said the operation was conducted in coordination with Damascus There was no immediate comment from Syrian authorities Five civilians including women and children were killed as a result of the Jordanian strikes a health official told Syrias state news agency
